summaries.Romania: Romania shot down its first-ever drone incursion, a Russian Shahed model that penetrated 200km into national airspace, in a seven-minute operation involving Romanian F-16s and Italian Eurofighter jets. The incident underscores escalating security threats from the Ukraine war and has drawn international attention to Romania's critical defensive posture on NATO's eastern flank.
summaries.Healthcare: OpenAI expanded Health in ChatGPT to all US users, enabling integration with medical records and wellness apps, while the FDA panel approved compounding of multiple peptides championed by RFK Jr. despite lacking human safety data. The healthcare AI landscape is rapidly shifting toward consumer-facing tools and less-regulated therapeutic compounds.
summaries.Tech: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, matching near-flagship Fable 5 performance at half the cost, while Trump threatened retaliation against EU tech fines and multiple companies including Qualcomm announced significant price increases citing component shortages. AI capability-per-dollar is accelerating even as hardware costs surge and geopolitical tensions reshape the tech supply chain.
